history.rationale: Position 47 is a conserved cysteine in the RING domain critical for zinc binding and E3 ubiquitin ligase activity. Mutation to serine is likely to abolish DNA repair function while not severely destabilizing the fold.
WT residue at position 47 is I (Isoleucine) per direct sequence lookup; C47S is invalid and must be rejected before any tool evaluation.

history.rationale: Position 24 (C) lies in RING domain essential for BRCA1 E3 ligase activity and tumor suppression. C24S disrupts zinc coordination likely causing LOF without major folding disruption.
Phenotype evidence shows near-maximal LOF pathogenicity while MSA frequency of S is low, confirming intolerance at conserved RING position without major folding disruption.
